race.description: Ladbrokes Tote Win +10% In October Mdn Plate
race.comment: VALAROSO (4) tried hard first up at Caulfield Heath over 1100m when just shaded a long neck as a $2.60 hope. He was thought highly enough of to debut in a $1 million race and ran a good fifth, with further improvement he'll go close here. KEEN OBSERVER (1) has placed in all four runs to date, short in the market each time. He's been costly and draws wide here but looks a strong hope again. CALL ME LATER (5) is a filly by Too Darn Hot on debut for the Moody & Coleman yard who has jumped out nicely and draws in. RESONANT (3) resumes having tackled some handy races last time in, watch the market fresh, similarly GIMONNET (7) who didn't measure up in blacktype at two but has jumped out well.
